name.description: The unique and required name of this instance.

issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

vectorStore.description:
If specified, then this is the {@link Genai.Retriever} that will be used by the Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine to retrive
similar passages.

numPassages.description:
The number of relevant passages to query the vector store for search results that populate
the grid below the main answer and rationale. This parameter DOES NOT affect either the answer or rationale.
This is typically much higher than executorParams -> numSources which corresponds to the
number of sources retrieved for each hop.

suppressSourceRelations.description:
If true, then source relations will be not be persisted or returned for results when using this config.
This may be useful for cases where the data points to only a single source file.

extractionConfigName.description:
The Extractor config {@link Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine.REA.ExtractorConfig} name.
If empty, the extractor step will be skipped.

rerankerConfigName.description:
The Reranker config {@link Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine.REA.RerankerConfig} name.
If empty, the reranking step will be skipped.

chatWithFullHistory.description:
Whether to use the full history of chat in REA question answering.
By default, a new standalone question (with sufficient context) is created (re-written) based on the chat history and passed to the LLM.
If this is set to true, the full chat history can be passed to the LLM, along with the latest (non-rewritten) question.

attributionSpec.description:
Spec for {@link Genai.Agent.Tool.Util.Attributor#attribute}.
If not set, new attribution with corroboration will not run.

noPredictionsWithNoneExtracts.description:
Whether to invoke the question answering model if all extracts are none or not.
If True we return "I am unable to answer your question" and will not invoke question answering. The default is False.

maxOutputTokens.description:
The maximum output tokens to be generated
 (only used for the API-based models for controlling cost). The default is 1000.

temperature.description:
The temperature variable used for increasing randomness of predictions o
(only used for the API-based models for controlling determinism). The default is 0 (fully deterministic).

extractorMetadataFormat.description: If adding metadata before running the extractor into the contexts from the {@link Genai.SourceFile.Metadata}, the format to use e.g. `{page_content} filename:{fileName}`. If `{page_content}` is omitted, it will be prepended when formatting the contexts.

rerankerMetadataFormat.description: If adding metadata before running the reranker into the contexts from the {@link Genai.SourceFile.Metadata}, the format to use e.g. `{page_content} filename:{fileName}`. If `{page_content}` is omitted, it will be prepended when formatting the contexts.

contextualQARemoveTags.description: Whether to extract and remove tags before using the contexts for contextual QA

contextualQAMetadataFormat.description: If adding metadata before running the contextual question answerer into the contexts from the {@link Genai.SourceFile.Metadata}, the format to use e.g. `{page_content} filename:{fileName}`. If `{page_content}` is omitted, it will be prepended when formatting the contexts.

engineThreadPoolSpec.description:
Configuration for {@link Engine.DeploySpec#threadPool} for {@link Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine}.
Any fields specified here will override the defaults.

streamTimeoutSeconds.description: For any response that is streamed, consider it failed after this many seconds.

title: Describes the config for setting up the REA pipeline.
name: Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine.REA.PipelineConfig
